mapper.select: SELECT b.id AS batch_id, b.expiry_date, b.quality_status, b.qty_total, b.qty_avail, b.qty_frozen, b.qty_sold, s.id AS stock_id, s.location_id, s.qty AS quantity, s.qty_frozen AS frozen, l.status AS location_status, CASE WHEN l.id IS NOT NULL AND s.drug_id = b.drug_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS valid_location FROM ph_inv_batch b JOIN ph_warehouse w ON w.id = b.warehouse_id AND w.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND w.store_id = b.store_id AND w.deleted = b'0' LEFT JOIN ph_inv_location_stock s ON s.batch_id = b.id AND s.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND s.deleted = b'0' LEFT JOIN ph_location l ON l.id = s.location_id AND l.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND l.warehouse_id = b.warehouse_id AND l.deleted = b'0' WHERE b.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND b.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND b.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND b.drug_id = #{drugId} AND b.deleted = b'0' ORDER BY b.id, s.id LIMIT 10001
